title: Descartes Colloquium: Lost Children in the Archives: Science, Psychiatry and Juvenile Justice in Australia 1800-1999
speaker: Kylie Smith
description: Descartes Centre Colloquium / Cultural History Seminar with Descartes Centre Fellow Kylie Smith, on how nineteenth- and twentieth-century child psychiatry shaped juvenile justice in Australia, and the ethics of archival sources about children. Note: starts half an hour earlier than usual. Replaces the UPAC Colloquium this week.
